title: Inverse image respects the specified constant-unit comparison
statement: For finite commutative A and f:X -> Y, ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback.hom followed by constantUnit X.hom equals ordinaryFinitePullback f applied to constantUnit Y.hom, followed by leftDerivedUpperStarDerivedTensorUnitIso f.hom [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data].

proof.text: Use constantUnit_hom and unitPullback_native_hom to replace the specified maps by their native single-degree unit and constant comparisons. The source-library formula leftDerivedUpperStar_map_singleFunctorObjUnitIso_inv_comp identifies the paths after composing with the inverses of the single-degree unit comparisons. A generic cancellation of these two isomorphisms proves the displayed equation.

lean.statement:
theorem constantUnit_pullback
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom ≫ (constantUnit A X).hom =
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map (constantUnit A Y).hom ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarDerivedTensorUnitIso f).hom
